title: Launch cadence, scope-freeze policy, and cut criteria for unified API/Console/Runtime release
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define a predictable launch cadence, scope-freeze policy, and explicit cut criteria that govern the joint release of API, Console, and Runtime components. This ticket coordinates cross-team deliverables (engineering, design, docs, customer success, security) and produces the release checklist, release notes template, and a go/no-go decision matrix for the April 2026 unified release.
acceptance_criteria: Scope-freeze date set and communicated to all teams (no non-critical scope after freeze),
Cut criteria checklist (performance, security, QA, docs, e2e) finalized and signed off by owners,
Release notes template created and assigned to owners for each subsystem (API, Console, Runtime),
Cross-team rollout plan with canary thresholds, monitoring dashboards, and rollback steps documented,
Go/no-go decision call schedule and gate owners identified and calendar invites sent
milestones: 2026-03-12: Draft cut criteria reviewed in cross-functional sync (status: complete)
2026-03-20: Finalize scope freeze (last day for feature inclusion)
2026-03-28: Code freeze for non-critical changes; only hotfixes accepted
2026-04-01: Release candidate build and integrated smoke tests
2026-04-05: Go/No-Go gating call and final signoffs
rollout_steps: Phase 0: Internal dogfooding with opt-in flag for 48 hours
Phase 1: 5% canary in us-west for 24 hours with latency/cost SLO guardrails
Phase 2: 25% regional expansion with automated fallback to previous runtime variant on error spike
Phase 3: 100% gradual ramp over 72 hours with increased observability retention for first 7 days
Post-release: 30% traffic kept on legacy routing for 7 days as contingency
risks: Runtime regression under long-sequence workloads causing latency SLO breaches (mitigation: pre-release load tests and KV cache validation),
Incomplete or inconsistent release notes across subsystems causing customer confusion (mitigation: centralized release notes owner and template),
Security signoff delay for Private deployment changes (mitigation: early engagement with security and pre-scheduled review slots),
Go-to-market docs or marketing assets not aligned with shipped scope (mitigation: weekly sync with GTM and final asset freeze 48hrs after scope freeze)
decisions: Adopt a 2-week soft cadence with a hard scope-freeze two weeks before public rollout (decision made 2026-03-12),
Use performance regression >5% p95 latency or >2x CPU as automatic blocker for release (agreed with runtime leads),
Centralize release notes in a single Drive folder with per-subsystem owners responsible for final copy (owner: Product Ops),
All release-critical security changes require security-review complete before code freeze; any exception needs explicit risk register entry
